sections.title: Hero
sections.feedback: Move the side cards even higher, and only a little tighter on the overlap.

implementationNote.summary: Reduced the per-card vertical step substantially and increased the horizontal overlap only slightly. Vertical step went from clamp(22px, 2.6vw, 38px) to clamp(12px, 1.6vw, 24px) -- at 1440px the side-card drop went from 37/75px to 23/46px, so the fan is noticeably flatter and the cards sit higher, closer to level with the central AI OS card. Horizontal overlap went from clamp(-74px, -5.2vw, -52px) to clamp(-80px, -5.6vw, -58px), about 6px more per side -- a small tightening, not another big tuck. Reserved padding below the deck reduced from clamp(48px, 5.4vw, 84px) to clamp(40px, 4.6vw, 72px) to match the shorter fan.
implementationNote.unchanged: Rotation (5.5deg per slot), the centred identity treatment, the canonical card outline token, motion, and every other section. Zero horizontal overflow; five live hero canvases; mobile 2-up grid resets transforms and is unaffected.
